title: The Shipping News
author: Annie Proulx
summary: Quoyle, a clumsy, unlucky newspaperman, moves with his young daughters to his family's ancestral home in Newfoundland after a personal disaster, and takes a job writing about the shipping news.
readIf: you like atmospheric stories with unusual prose and a damaged hero finding his feet.
skipIf: you want conventional sentences and a fast-moving plot.
